name: 🌊 +1 Speed Tsunami Escape in Brainrot
desc:
🎉 Welcome to 🌊 +1 Speed Tsunami Escape in Brainrot! 🎮

✨ How to Play:
🚀 Step on the speed pads to go SUPER FAST!
🧠 Collect other brainrots to get even MORE speed!
🏁 Race to the finish line to unlock the BEST brainrots!
😄 And most importantly… HAVE FUN!

💖 Don’t forget:
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support us!
👥 Join our group to get awesome in-game boosts!
